biggestRisk: Scope against an unknown deployment: the plan builds a full hosted account system (email auth, Postgres, service worker, CSP, two device kinds, history/restore UI) for a game whose only server today is a 127.0.0.1 file-keeper. If players really run it locally with npm start, the localhost-to-hosted CORS bridge and the 'Is this your school?' claim become the main path, and that is the least-designed part. The stranger flags this uncertainty itself and could not know the owner's house rule against accounts and data leaving the machine.
